newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ, Ansett to merge NZ freight business.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ, Ansett to merge NZ freight business.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd and Ansett Australia Holdings Ltd are planning to merge their New Zealand domestic air freight and courier businesses -- Air NZ First Express and Ansett NZ Air Freight Ltd -- Air NZ said on Wednesday.
"The plan is to bring the two organisations together to operate more effectively in the increasingly competitive New Zealand freight and courier markets," it said in a statement.
The merged business will be established as an equal partnership.
Further information will be provided on the plan as details are finalised.
Ansett is jointly owned by Air New Zealand and News Ltd. Air NZ bought its half share in Ansett last year from TNT Ltd in a complex deal worth A$475 million.
